items.title: Tokenomics Committee approves cBNB as a featured asset and pauses three featured apps over Canton Coin locking rules
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 21, 2026 · 1:51 PM ET)

- **Tokenomics Committee approves cBNB as a featured asset and pauses three featured apps over Canton Coin locking rules** — The committee approved cBNB, issued by Nuxaris, as a featured asset, and paused Obligate, Obligate issuer and the Interstice Cross-Chain Swap Engine because they do not meet the CIP-0116 Canton Coin locking requirement; cBNB's liquidity on three trading venues will be reviewed on December 7, 2026, and its featured status will be revoked if it does not pass (CC Space)
- **Canton Coin's open-interest-weighted futures funding flips back negative to 0.0102% as liquidations ease to $23,160** — Coinfuty's live November 21 read puts the open-interest-weighted funding rate at negative 0.0102% per four hours, back below zero from positive 0.0026% recorded in the 1236 edition, with 24-hour liquidations at $23,160, almost all of them longs at $23,140 against $17.95 in shorts, futures open interest at $33.30 million, futures volume at $13.97 million and an aggregate long-to-short ratio of 0.853 across 13 tracked exchanges (Coinfuty)

items.title: CapConnect+ can earn up to five Super Validator weight units under CIP-0131, tied to commercial-paper settlement milestones on Canton
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 21, 2026 · 12:51 PM ET)

- **CapConnect+ can earn up to five Super Validator weight units under CIP-0131, tied to commercial-paper settlement milestones on Canton** — The approval, passed with 12 votes in favour and one non-vote, sets one unit for first production atomic settlements of at least $100 million in aggregate within six months, one unit for bringing at least two US corporate commercial-paper participants into production within nine months, and three units for cumulative Canton-settled issuance of $1 billion, $5 billion and $10 billion within nine, 12 and 18 months, with the top two thresholds also requiring at least 120 and 200 settlement events; the platform aims to settle both the debt instrument and its payment on Canton, with DiSH or compatible onchain cash for the payment side, and its more than $46.11 billion of issuance since early 2025 used existing infrastructure and is not Canton volume (CantonNews)

items.title: Canton docs walk through cross-synchronizer DvP settlement, with atomic exchange as the fifth of six steps
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 6:42 PM ET)

- **Canton docs walk through cross-synchronizer DvP settlement, with atomic exchange as the fifth of six steps** — The worked example settles a trade between a buyer whose cash sits on a Payments synchronizer and a seller whose securities sit on a Securities synchronizer: both contracts are first reassigned, in two phases each, to a common Settlement synchronizer such as the Global Synchronizer, then a single Daml transaction archives the original cash and securities contracts and creates new ones with the owners swapped, so either both transfers happen or neither does; the reassignments themselves can leave a contract temporarily unusable in a pending state but carry no settlement risk, because no value changes hands until the atomic step executes, and afterwards the new contracts can optionally be reassigned back to their home synchronizers (Canton Network Docs)

items.title: Canton docs publish a recovery runbook for validators stuck after the November 7 MainNet upgrade
items.body:

items.title: Obsidian outlines three Canton standards projects covering clear signing, validator access checks and personal-data handling
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 20, 2026 · 5:42 AM ET)

- **Obsidian outlines three Canton standards projects covering clear signing, validator access checks and personal-data handling** — The three early outlines, each seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion and a technical reviewer, cover signed, readable descriptions of application transactions that wallets and custody systems could verify and display, with an unverified fallback for transactions without a published description; a common rulebook and read-only checker comparing validator users, rights and identity-provider settings, reporting problems without changing access itself; and an eight-month plan for a specification, Daml library and supporting component for handling personally identifiable information, including verifiable erasure; the team says the projects would be open source, and the outlines are proposals being prepared rather than adopted standards or approved grants, with the clear-signing work also needing to account for transaction-review work already underway through Digital Asset and Blockdaemon's Wallet Gateway (CCTools)
- **Sync Insights introduces a multi-wallet view that separates internal transfers from external flows on Canton** — The new view combines balances, rewards, fees and activity across a user's Canton parties in one place, and separates transfers between the user's included wallets from external flows, helping avoid treating internal movements as fresh income or spending; the listing announcement does not establish a particular level of adoption (CCTools)

items.title: Fairmint backs the SEC's transfer-agent modernization, asking that onchain shareholder registers be judged by the same tests as conventional ones
items.body:

- **DTCC will add Stellar in the first half of 2027 and Circle's Arc and Solana in the second half to its tokenization service, keeping Canton as its core near term** — Canton was the first network DTCC partnered with on tokenization, in December 2025, and its Tokenization Service launched in October 2026 on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network under agreements with 20 participants, letting them turn entitlements to stocks, ETFs and Treasuries held at DTC into tokens carrying the same legal rights and transferable 24 hours a day between registered wallets; the multi-chain additions are still at the planning stage, so Canton is expected to serve as the core of the service's ecosystem in the near term (Tiger Research)
- **Obsidian Systems prepares a machine-checked semantics of Daml-LF 2 so Canton analysis tools can be tested against one public model** — The proposal under RFP 22, on Daml security standards, would build an executable semantics of Daml-LF 2.x and the Canton ledger model in Agda in a public Apache-2.0 repository over 12 months, delivering a core semantics that agrees with the Daml engine on the Daml Script tests of 20 real packages and rejects seeded authorisation defects, plus proofs on Splice code covering authorisation, Canton Coin issuance, the CIP-0098 reward cap and the CIP-0105 lock schedule, with part of the grant paid only on outside adoption; it is seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion and a technical reviewer (Canton Network Forum)
- **BlockBot seeks a wallet review for a WhatsApp-based AI wallet interface for Canton under RFP 14** — The Development Fund proposal, filed as pull request 1056 under RFP 14 on wallet and dApp integration tooling, presents BlockBot as a WhatsApp-based AI wallet interface designed to make Canton interactions more accessible while providing reusable wallet and dApp integration tooling, and asks the Wallet Apps and dApp Integration group for a technical review of its wallet architecture, signing flow, security model and alignment with ecosystem priorities, and for a champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **About 79% of updates recorded on Canton in a 24-hour period in November were private, as the network keeps most activity visible only to its parties** — The figure reflects Canton's sub-transaction privacy model, in which each participant's node receives only the parts of a transaction it is involved in while the Global Synchronizer orders encrypted messages and confirms transactions without seeing their contents, a design intended to let institutions issue, trade and settle tokenized assets together without showing positions, client data or collateral flows to competitors (Decrypt)

items.title: Predge seeks a champion for conditional x402 payments on Canton, released only by a signed delivery verdict
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 3:12 PM ET)

- **Predge seeks a champion for conditional x402 payments on Canton, released only by a signed delivery verdict** — x402 payments on Canton are final at the moment of the call today, with no way back short of a manual refund if the paid job is not delivered; Predge's draft proposal would lock the amount in a Daml escrow contract instead, with a verifier checking delivery against criteria agreed up front and issuing an ed25519-signed verdict that anyone can verify offline, recorded on the ledger to release the funds or refund the payer, and the payer able to reclaim on their own if no verdict arrives in time; the same escrow-plus-verdict design has been live on Arc mainnet since September 2026 and on 16 EVM mainnets, settling a GPU rental per verified day on November 12 where the A100 days were paid and a day the host swapped in an A40 was refunded by the contract, and the draft plan runs about four months at about 600,000 Canton Coin over three milestones, seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion under RFP 13 and not yet funded (Canton Network Forum)
- **A Daml bytes and cryptography library seeks 300,000 Canton Coin to give developers the byte operations Daml lacks natively** — The Apache-2.0 library plus DPM component, proposed under RFP 16 with RFP 19 elements, asks for 300,000 Canton Coin over nine weeks in three milestones of 100,000 each and has been open for review since October 23 with status Needs Champion; Daml has no byte array type, so bytes from other systems use hex-encoded text and every team writes the remaining operations itself, and the scope covers byte operations, documented cryptography wrappers, RLP encoding and decoding, and binary Merkle and Ethereum Patricia trie proof verification, with the proof of concept's RLP encoder passing all 28 official ethereum/tests vectors, its signature verification passing 8 of 8 Wycheproof assertions and its keccak256 output matching Foundry's cast byte for byte, and the repository stays private until Milestone 1 publishes it (Canton Network Forum)
- **Tradecraft's locked value eases to $1.41 million as the Canton AMM's slide from its October peak continues** — DefiLlama's daily snapshots put the automated market maker and liquidity layer at $1.41 million on November 19, down from $1.44 million on November 18 and above the $1.39 million low on November 15, against an all-time high of $1.74 million on October 31; users swap Canton-native and bridged assets on Tradecraft and provide liquidity to earn trading fees, with 100% of its tracked locked value on Canton (DefiLlama)
- **A new guide sets out how Canton governs itself through the CIP process, with sponsorship and a two-thirds vote before any change takes effect** — Anyone can author a Canton Improvement Proposal, and the discussion period runs three months for Standards Track proposals and one month each for Governance and Tokenomics proposals; moving to a vote requires sponsorship from two Super Validators, which signals the proposal is worth voting on rather than endorsing it, the Super Validator voting window lasts 10 days with approval requiring a two-thirds supermajority and no single entity holding veto power, and a proposal reaches Final status only after two-thirds of Super Validators have implemented the change on-chain, moving through DevNet and TestNet before MainNet (CantonNews)

items.title: CoBuilders proposes a sandbox testing library so JavaScript and TypeScript teams stop rebuilding their own Canton test harnesses
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)

- **CoBuilders proposes a sandbox testing library so JavaScript and TypeScript teams stop rebuilding their own Canton test harnesses** — STL, proposed under RFP 18, is an open-source npm package that starts and stops the Canton Sandbox, creates fresh parties and users for each test, and already runs unchanged OpenZeppelin contracts against a real Sandbox in public CI in its beta; the grant would add authenticated submission and queries, control of ledger time through static time, party and contract lookup helpers, compatibility tests, three migration pull requests for independent projects and a Node.js testing tutorial, with a request for 400,000 Canton Coin over eight weeks of development and twelve months of maintenance, of which 69,000 coins are paid only when an independent project adopts STL in its own CI, and the proposal is seeking feedback and a champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **A native IBC v2 proposal would connect Canton directly to Cosmos chains without a custom bridge for each chain** — The BeencoLabs proposal would write IBC v2 core and ICS-20 transfers in Daml, so any Cosmos chain on a recent ibc-go could send assets to Canton through its existing transfer module and received assets would land as CIP-56 holdings that work in existing Canton wallets and applications; the gateway would run as a decentralised party with a confirmation threshold so no single operator can move funds, the first scope is one working connection between Canton DevNet or TestNet and one Cosmos testnet covering transfers in, transfers out and timeout refunds with an open-source relayer path and documentation, and the proposal is seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton DeFi locked value eases to $11.2 million as 24-hour DEX volume rises to $16.85 million** — DefiLlama's November 19 evening read puts total value locked at $11.2 million, down 2.76% over 24 hours from the $11.32 million snapshot recorded this morning, while 24-hour DEX volume rose to $16.85 million from $16.41 million in that morning read, across the eight protocols DefiLlama tracks on Canton (DefiLlama)

items.title: Digital Asset introduces covalidation services so Canton parties can spread transaction confirmation across independent operators
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)

- **Digital Asset introduces covalidation services so Canton parties can spread transaction confirmation across independent operators** — The November 19 introduction lets a party be multi-hosted so several nodes share confirmation duties, including threshold settings such as two approvals from three covalidators before a transaction confirms, with no single node able to confirm alone and services able to continue if one node becomes unavailable; 5N Loop, T-RIZE and Bron are already using multi-hosted infrastructure, 5N Loop became the first Canton wallet where every new participant is multi-party hosted using Digital Asset and MPCH as independent operators, and Digital Asset, MPCH and Kiln are among the early covalidation service providers, building on underlying capabilities delivered in May 2026 (Crypto Economy)
- **Obsidian Systems prepares an access rulebook and read-only checker for Canton validator logins under RFP 25** — The proposal would build an open Apache-2.0 standard covering how identity-provider logins and Canton users and rights are set up, a read-only checker that reads a validator's users, rights and identity provider and reports each broken rule with how to fix it without changing anything, a mapping from each rule to audit requirements such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and DORA, and tested setup recipes, with part of the grant paid only when operators outside Obsidian run the checker on their own TestNet or MainNet validators; it is seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion and technical reviewer and is distinct from the same firm's RFP 26 clear-signing proposal (Canton Network Forum)
- **Ditto seeks guidance on bringing working yield vaults to Canton, starting from a private DevNet prototype** — Ditto, which operates a Canton MainNet validator, says it has built a private prototype for Canton DevNet using Canton Token Standard interfaces, with application accounting and processing queues currently maintained off-ledger, and is asking which vault interfaces, packages and versions are ready to use today, which priority protocol integrations or operational workflows sit outside existing vault proposals, and whether a maintainer or integration partner would review a small scope before it defines a Development Fund proposal (Canton Network Forum)
- **Canton's represented tokenized assets on RWA.xyz rise to $370.5 billion in the November 12 read, all of it in recordkeeping form** — The updated figure, up from the $320.7 billion snapshot served on November 18, puts Canton at 88.6% of the $418.2 billion in represented value RWA.xyz tracks across networks, while the same read shows $0 in distributed tokens held in investor wallets, 0 holders and $0 of transfers in the last 30 days, so the ranking reflects ledger recordkeeping rather than distributed onchain holdings (Daniil Kozin, reporting RWA.xyz)

items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 12:42 PM ET)

- **Obsidian Systems prepares a clear-signing proposal so Canton wallets can show users what they are actually approving** — Most Canton wallets today decode only a handful of transaction types, mostly transfers, and show little more than a fingerprint for other applications, leaving the wallet screen as the last chance to catch a compromised transaction; the proposal under RFP 26 would deliver an open format for signed, human-readable transaction descriptions, a library wallets and custody systems can use to verify and display them, and a readable fallback marked unverified for applications without a published description, all under Apache-2.0 and building on an approved developer-keys grant, and it is seeking a Tech & Ops Committee champion and technical reviewer while noting related transaction-visualisation work already underway at Digital Asset and Blockdaemon (Canton Network Forum)

- **OnePump lowers its stated trading charges, with the first trade each day free** — Under the November 18 fee announcement, trades of 900 Canton Coin or more carry no network fee and other trades cost 1 Canton Coin, with the larger-trade exemption referring specifically to the network fee rather than every possible trading cost (CantonNews)
- **A canton-upgrade proposal requests 220,000 Canton Coin for tools to move live Daml packages from one version to the next** — The Development Fund submission proposes eight commands — validate, rehearse, vet-status, pin, status, migrate, unvet and gate — covering checks of the live participant, counterparty vetting, package pinning, contract counts, migration, safe unvetting and continuous integration, delivered in three milestones over about a month and verified on LocalNet, DevNet, TestNet and MainNet; the proposal still needs a champion and is not a funded or released toolkit (GitHub)

items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 19, 2026 · 11:12 AM ET)

- **Krasilnikoff Credit & Collateral adds a fifth Canton benchmark, a Burn/Mint Ratio, in methodology version 0.14** — The new measurement, effective for the November 13 sheet, compares traffic-related Canton Coin burns with estimated gross issuance over a defined period, joining benchmarks for liquidation capacity, the dollar borrowing rate, the Canton Coin borrow rate and reward coverage; it requires at least 27 valid days in a 30-day window, so its first full 30-day value is still being built and is expected on the November 28 sheet, and its traffic-burn figures come from Canton Scan snapshots while gross mint is inferred from supply changes plus measured burns rather than counted directly (CantonNews)
- **Canton's data-access layer now runs well beyond the ledger itself, with Noves supporting more than 100 participants and CC View logging about 6.05 million requests** — Noves' self-hosted Data App, which lets organisations read only the information their own authorised participants can see, reports support for more than 100 validators, applications and strategic partners, while CC View, PixelPlex's Canton explorer and indexing service covering transfers, parties, prices, rewards and governance, reports about 6.05 million total API requests at a 0.02% historical error rate; both figures are provider-reported rather than independently audited (CantonNews)
- **Bit Dynamics' Canton DevKit campaign offers a 5,000 Canton Coin draw through November 24 for running a complete local network** — The DevKit runs a full local Canton network on a developer's own machine — two validator nodes and a Super Validator, each with its own party, managed from one command-line tool or a local web interface — covering DAR uploads, contract inspection, token flows and portable network snapshots; entering requires the campaign's social tasks, a qualifying DevKit run, which means minting a token on the local network and posting it, triples a participant's entries, and 3,436 participants had joined at the latest read, with the 5,000 CC valued at about $410.40 (CCTools)

items.title: Canton sets dated MainNet steps for traffic-based app rewards, with a dry run starting December 8 and full effect targeted for early February
items.body:

- **The IMF's October stability report puts intraday repo and legal certainty at the centre of tokenization's next phase, with Canton's repo scale as its evidence** — The International Monetary Fund's Global Financial Stability Report chapter "Scaling Tokenization: New Efficiencies, New Vulnerabilities" says growth depends on legal certainty, regulatory clarity, interoperability and safe settlement assets under technology-neutral rules, and highlights intraday repo as a priority use case, evidenced by the $350 billion-plus a day in tokenized repo facilitated by Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo on Canton; Digital Asset's response argues the report underplays privacy — mentioned only twice in nearly thirty pages — and that central banks and clearing houses still need to clarify when tokenized assets count as eligible collateral (Digital Asset)

- **Institutions sit on about $25 billion of excess or unremunerated collateral overnight, ValueExchange research finds** — The average financial institution pledges and manages up to $74 billion in collateral, yet about a quarter of it is excess or earns nothing overnight and 7% of firms post excess collateral purely for buffering; moving collateral atomically against cash, in minutes and at any hour, is the efficiency case behind the collateral-mobility flows now running on Canton (ValueExchange research, via Digital Asset)

items.body:

items.title: OpenAssets brings its markets-in-a-box tokenization platform to Canton as a DA Registry implementation partner
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 10:12 AM ET)
- **OpenAssets brings its markets-in-a-box tokenization platform to Canton as a DA Registry implementation partner** — In the November 5 collaboration with Digital Asset, OpenAssets will make its platform, which combines tokenized asset issuance, settlement, compliance, asset management and distribution in one stack, available to institutions on Canton, serving as an implementation partner for DA Registry, Digital Asset's tokenization engine; DA Registry adds allowlist, blocklist and transfer-approval controls connected to external KYC and AML providers, only the parties to a transaction can see it on Canton, and assets can take part in atomic settlement, collateral management and cross-application lending, with DA Registry already enabling more than 30 issuers and tokenization platforms on the network and no launch date or first customer disclosed (PR Newswire)
- **Canton accounts for $320.7 billion of the $366 billion in represented tokenized assets tracked on RWA.xyz** — The November 7 snapshot puts Canton far ahead of other networks on that measure, with the total almost entirely driven by Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo platform, which uses Canton technology to manage short-term repo loans backed by U.S. government bonds and reported $7.5 trillion in transaction volume for September 2026; represented assets are positions recorded on the ledger rather than freely traded onchain assets, and Finadium analysts describe Canton at this stage as a specialised record-keeping layer rather than a decentralised distribution network (RWA Signal)
- **About 79% of Canton transactions were executed privately in a 24-hour November window** — The November 14 review, drawing on CantonScan data, puts roughly 79% of transactions over the window as fully private under Daml-based smart contracts, with Digital Asset's institutional expansion supported by its $355 million June 2026 funding round and the October 2026 DTCC tokenization rollout; the figure describes the share of private execution, not total network volume (Basis Desk)

items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 8:42 AM ET)

- **OpenZeppelin's Canton Daml library and four reference designs clear the Dev Fund vote** — OpenZeppelin, the smart-contract security firm recently acquired by S&P Global, has had its open-source Daml contracts library and four reference application designs for Canton — a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and one further design — approved by Digital Asset and passed by the Dev Fund committee, giving teams building financial apps on Canton vetted, reusable building blocks instead of starting from scratch (Canton Network Forum)
- **Rome Protocol launches Ostia, a zero-knowledge EVM chain settling on Canton** — Rome Protocol has put Ostia live on Canton DevNet as an Ethereum-compatible chain whose blocks are proved with zero-knowledge proofs and settled in a single Canton transaction, with a bridge that moves Canton Coin and ERC-20 tokens between the two sides; the code is open source, so Solidity developers can now deploy to a chain that settles on Canton, and the launch is on DevNet, not MainNet (Canton Network Forum)
- **DTCC plans to connect its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027, with a Stellar connection planned for the first half** — The service launched on Canton and DTCC's private Besu network on October 28 and runs under agreements with 20 participants, and the November 15 expansion plan was characterised as a multichain strategy rather than a move away from Canton, so Canton remains the first live venue while the other connections are future work (CoinStats)

- **ChainSafe now runs the Canton DevNet endpoints OpenZeppelin uses to build and test its Daml contract libraries** — ChainSafe announced on November 16 that it will deploy, operate and maintain the DevNet API endpoints for OpenZeppelin, covering smart-contract package upload endpoints and Ledger API read and write access, so OpenZeppelin can deploy its Daml libraries and tooling and test them against a live network as it expands its Contracts library and reference implementations to Canton; ChainSafe is itself a Canton Super Validator, and the arrangement is DevNet testing infrastructure, not a MainNet application launch or a completed security audit (ChainSafe)
- **CIP-0132, the first technical paymaster model for Universal Burn, moves from discussion draft to a formal vote** — The proposal opened for voting on November 16, with Digital Asset as Super Validator sponsor and Five North as endorser, and sets out three steps for dedicated synchronizers: measure the synchronizer's traffic, have a designated paymaster burn Canton Coin after that traffic is consumed, and record activity that can qualify for rewards; this first phase still relies on the operator and paymaster to report usage accurately and does not yet enforce traffic limits, and the vote opening is not approval or deployment of the model, which builds on the already-approved Universal Burn framework in CIP-0129 (CantonNews)
- **Alpend gives ONE its own protocol identity as Adula, separating issuance from its private lending platform** — Palladium Labs introduced Adula on November 16 as the home for ONE, its privacy-native collateralized debt position protocol issuing ONE against collateral on Canton, while Alpend continues to focus on private lending and borrowing; the underlying mechanics are unchanged and each protocol now has its own identity and governance path, public minting of ONE against Canton Coin remains listed as coming soon, and swaps between USDCx and ONE remain available only in its open private beta (CantonNews)
- **Canton maintainers are testing a recovery runbook for validators that fell out of consensus after the MainNet Logical Synchronizer Upgrade** — A November 16 maintainer update says a small percentage of active MainNet validator nodes were unprepared for the most recent Logical Synchronizer Upgrade, having missed the minimum Splice version, and fell out of consensus; maintainers are sharing a finalized recovery procedure with a small number of validator operators to validate it and correct any unclear documentation, and planned to revisit progress the next morning US Eastern, after which a validated runbook would be posted publicly and added to the official Disaster Recovery documentation; the update does not say all affected validators have recovered (Canton Network Forum)

items.title: Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 18, 2026 · 3:12 AM ET)
- **Canton Strategic Holdings doubles third-quarter revenue to $3.05 million and turns adjusted EBITDA positive for the first time** — The Nasdaq-listed company (CNTN) reported on November 16 total revenue of $3,051,232 for the quarter ended September 30, up 104% from $1,495,859 in the second quarter, in its first full quarter of Super Validator and locking-as-a-service operations; network validation revenue rose to $1,503,238 as active Super Validator weight climbed from 0.5 to 6.5 of 15 approved, other revenue was $1,547,994, mostly locking-as-a-service, and adjusted EBITDA was $610,414 against a loss of $820,449 in the second quarter, while a $54.65 million unrealized loss on its digital-asset holdings drove a net loss of $35,078,297 (PR Newswire)
- **Nomura, NRI and BOOSTRY set out a joint plan to connect financial firms to onchain markets on Canton** — In their November 16 announcement, NRI is developing a service that captures blockchain transactions and balances in real time into its I-STAR securities back-office systems, BOOSTRY says its Canton-first institutional wallet entered production in September and that it has completed a protocol connecting Canton to its ibet for Fin digital-securities platform, and the three intend to examine government and corporate bonds, shares and funds from issuance through settlement and collateral use; the collaboration is still under consideration and builds on the single shared Super Validator arrangement approved under CIP-0130, with up to 10 reward weight in total (CantonNews)
- **Total Canton Coin burned passes 6.13 billion as fee burns run at about four coins for every five minted** — CantonScan data put the cumulative burn at 6.13 billion CC as of November 16, up from 6.05 billion recorded on November 15, with about $1.15 million worth burned in the 24 hours to November 16; because new CC is minted as rewards, burns at roughly 80% of minting mean supply still grows modestly rather than contracting, against about 40 billion CC in circulation (BSC News)
- **Splice release notes reach version 0.10.2, upgrading Canton to 3.7.3 and removing the last CometBFT support** — The 0.10.2 notes add CIP-104 v1.1 featured-asset activity fields to Scan event responses, add governance support for the amended traffic-based reward calculation, and remove the remaining CometBFT endpoints, metrics and charts from the Super Validator app; the release train follows the MainNet upgrade to Splice 0.10.0 that was listed for November 16 (Canton Network Docs)

items.title: Canton keeps issuance and settlement as separate jobs, unlike a single public ledger
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 15, 2026 · 1:12 PM ET)
- **Canton keeps issuance and settlement as separate jobs, unlike a single public ledger** — A Five North analysis in today's digest argues every securities market separates the issuer, who creates the claim, from the settlement layer, noting DTC custodies more than $100 trillion in securities and issues none of them; on Canton the issuing party's node controls the asset and its rules, synchronizers operated by other parties sequence and finalize transactions without holding or reading their contents, disclosure is selective, and settlement is still atomic across counterparties, with the stated tradeoff being the permissionless public composability of a single-ledger chain (CantonNews)
- **Silvana offers private trading on Canton, with orders matched away from public view and settled by delivery-versus-payment** — Silvana Book is a live private orderbook for tokenized assets: orders are matched privately, assets stay in the user's wallet with no escrow until the final trade settles on Canton, and the platform offers direct swaps, private requests for quote, grid strategies and permissioned trading agents; V2 adds a redesigned Trading Terminal, support for Lattice Wallet and an updated EarnHub for campaigns and settled-trade rewards (CantonNews)

items.title: Canton's governance runs through a single open CIP process, with more than 117 proposals approved to date
items.body:

- **Canton's governance runs through a single open CIP process, with more than 117 proposals approved to date** — CantonNews' guide to the Canton Improvement Proposal process sets out five proposal categories covering technical standards, governance, tokenomics, process and informational items, open to any public author with no gatekeeping, moving through drafting and working-group review to sponsorship by two Super Validators, a 10-day Super Validator vote requiring a two-thirds supermajority with no single-entity veto, and on-chain implementation through DevNet, TestNet and MainNet before Final status; cited examples include CIP-0056 on the token standard, CIP-0078 eliminating Canton Coin transfer fees and CIP-0117 introducing Logical Synchronizers (CantonNews)

items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 12:42 PM ET)
- **DTCC's plan to add Solana in 2027 puts Canton inside a broader multi-chain tokenization strategy** — DTCC announced on November 12 that it plans to connect its Tokenization Service to Solana in the second half of 2027, describing the move as part of a multi-chain strategy to let assets move between traditional infrastructure and several blockchain networks; the service launched on October 28 operating initially with the Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network, with 20 DTC participants signed at launch, so Canton is the network already integrated while the Solana connection is a future expansion, and the announcement does not establish a direct valuation measure for Canton Coin (ad-hoc-news)

items.body:

- **Sixty-seven companies object to OKXICE's third-party tokenization plans, putting issuer consent at the centre of the SEC exemption debate** — Of the 62 companies originally proposed for tokenization by OKXICE, the OKX and Intercontinental Exchange venture, 56 have formally objected, including all seven Magnificent Seven companies alongside Walmart, JPMorgan, Coca-Cola, Eli Lilly, Boeing and McDonald's, and 11 further companies outside the original list have also raised objections, leaving only Strategy, Robinhood, Coinbase, Circle, Securitize and BitGo not objecting; the dispute is over consent, because OKXICE would tokenize shares through an unaffiliated third party, while TSV on Canton tokenizes only with issuer sponsorship through Fairmint, the SEC-registered transfer agent behind its first Canton Strategic Holdings trades, and Nasdaq has separately opposed TSV's framework in favour of an issuer-centric approach inside existing regulated markets (CryptoFrontNews)

items.title: Governance locks bring Super Validator and Featured App locking enforcement on-chain under CIP-0127
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 9:12 AM ET)
- **Governance locks bring Super Validator and Featured App locking enforcement on-chain under CIP-0127** — The Canton documentation now details how governance locks will work from Splice 0.10.0: CIP-0105 requires Super Validators to lock a percentage of their aggregate lifetime rewards to keep their weight, CIP-0116 requires each Featured App provider to lock a minimum amount of Canton Coin to gain and keep featured status, and CIP-0127 is the functional specification that moves enforcement of both onto the ledger itself; every lock must hold at least 10,000 CC, Super Validator locks vest over 365.25 days after an unlock while Featured App locks vest over 60 days, and wallet providers have been asked to expand memo fields to 1,000 characters because lock data is encoded in the transfer memo in compatibility mode (Canton Network Docs)
- **SBI Holdings and Cambodia's central bank plan a tokenized government-bond trial on Canton** — SBI Holdings and the National Bank of Cambodia signed a memorandum of understanding on November 13 for a proof of concept in tokenized Cambodian government bonds, with Canton planned as the network and the aim of making bond investment accessible in smaller amounts through local financial institutions; the central bank will register and manage bondholder information, SBI Bank (Cambodia) will work on technical verification of tokenization and transfers, and SBI Digital Practice will build and operate the trial environment, with interim results and a demonstration planned for the Black Swan Summit in Phnom Penh on November 15–16, and a separate memorandum the same day covers a Japan–Cambodia remittance proof of concept; the bond work is a planned trial, not a live issuance (CantonNews)
- **CapConnect+ seeks a Super Validator role under CIP-0131 to settle commercial paper and its cash payment together on Canton** — The proposal, in a vote that opened November 10 with Tradeweb as sponsor and MPCH as endorser, offers a maximum of five reward weight units tied to delivery and adoption milestones, starting with at least $100 million in aggregate commercial-paper issuance settling both the asset and the cash on Canton within six months of approval, then cumulative milestones at $1 billion, $5 billion and $10 billion; the existing CapConnect+ platform, developed in collaboration with Walmart, has facilitated more than $46.11 billion in issuance since full production began in early 2025 on existing settlement infrastructure, which is not Canton volume, and the public document does not identify the anchor issuer for the first Canton transactions (CantonNews)
- **Canton Foundation launches an official Daml 3 developer certification, with free self-paced courses and a $150 exam** — The Canton Developer Certification, launched November 10, pairs free self-paced courses with a certification exam costing $150 per session and is based on Daml 3 and Canton 3.x, the current network stack; it validates practical mastery of Daml's authorization and privacy principles — controlling who may act on a contract and who may access its terms — and gives existing Daml 2 developers a migration path onto the single current platform, with Foundation chief operating officer Amanda Martin framing it as a common professional standard for building in regulated markets (HTX)
- **Canton Coin spot prices widen to 9.06% apart across exchanges, with only a thin best route after fees** — A November 14, 14:02 UTC scan found Canton Coin cheapest on MEXC at $0.07571 and dearest on Bitstamp at $0.082569 across 12 exchanges with a liquid spot market, wider than the 8.19% spread recorded earlier today; the best spot route, buying on Bybit and selling on Kraken, paid only 0.11% after taker fees, about $1.05 on $1,000 at the best book prices, with the transfer status between the exchanges unknown, the best futures route, long WhiteBIT perpetuals against short Lighter perpetuals, paid 0.73% after fees, and no route with a confirmed open transfer was worth taking (ArbitrageGap)

items.title: Canton selected to support a three-state RISE benefits pilot planned for the first quarter of 2027
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 7:12 AM ET)
- **Canton selected to support a three-state RISE benefits pilot planned for the first quarter of 2027** — The pilot would combine public benefit programs into scheduled payments while applying spending rules and limiting data access, demonstrating a use beyond financial markets; it is planned for the first quarter of 2027 but requires federal approval, and the participating states and programs have not been disclosed, so it is a planned pilot rather than confirmed large-scale adoption (CoinMarketCap)
- **Canton Strategic chief flags MEV costs for tokenized stocks, with privacy pitched as a safeguard** — Canton Strategic Holdings chief executive Mark Wendland warned on November 13 that maximum extractable value can create hidden costs when validators prioritize transactions, and said Canton's privacy protections and rules against paid transaction ordering are designed to reduce that exposure; the warning highlights execution quality as a live design concern for tokenized markets, and the report also noted tokenized share trades on Canton completed on November 4 (CoinMarketCap)
- **Rome Protocol's Ostia brings EVM tools to Canton DevNet, in an unaudited test release** — Ostia, an Ethereum-compatible chain from Rome Protocol, began running on Canton's developer test network on October 22, with the report appearing on November 12; it supports wrapped Canton Coin, but the release remains unaudited and experimental and is not evidence of production adoption (CoinMarketCap)
- **The Hub reports 1,000 members on Canton, combining creator content with tradable community tickets** — The Hub says its platform combines creator content, live rooms and tradable community tickets on Canton and has announced 1,000 members; the figure is a milestone reported by the project itself and follows an earlier SprintFAM creator-network partnership, although the posts do not establish how many sign-ups came from that collaboration (CantonNews)

items.title: Tritemius expands its iOS wallet through TestFlight, adding Canton assets and two Lightning options
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 6:12 AM ET)
- **Tritemius expands its iOS wallet through TestFlight, adding Canton assets and two Lightning options** — Tritemius Labs says the update, available through TestFlight rather than a confirmed general App Store release, adds support for cETH from onRails, HANDL from HandlPay and Edel's tokenized stock and index products labelled AAPL, MSTR, QQQ and SPY, plus a one-click Lightning option that needs no personal node and a personal-node option where the user runs the node and Tritemius acts as its controller; Lightning remains a separate Bitcoin payment capability alongside Canton asset support and does not settle on Canton (CantonNews)
- **REX-Osprey Canton Coin ETF passes its November 13 effective date with no ticker or trading launch confirmed** — A November 14 update notes the filing reached its post-effective amendment date of November 13, but no ticker or trading launch has been confirmed, and a separate review found no post-November 13 filing, exchange listing application or issuer statement confirming trading; the fund, a series of ETF Opportunities Trust, seeks 1x the performance of Canton Coin and would invest at least 80% of net assets in CC exposure, so effectiveness alone is not a market debut (CoinStats)
- **Memora says SOLx minting stops if its SOL reserve check fails, using RedStone CAPS on Canton** — Memora says each SOLx should be backed one-for-one by SOL held in reserve on Solana and that it is using RedStone CAPS to check the reserve on Canton before minting, with minting stopping if reserve data is unavailable or the figures do not match; the November 11 explanation describes the proposed safeguard, not a live bridge launch or independently verified reserves (CantonNews)
- **Cauri Wallet now charges network fees in Canton Coin on sends, a cost it previously covered** — From November 11, Cauri began requiring users to pay network fees in CC on sends; the change shifts a cost the wallet previously absorbed onto the sender, and it applies as a network-fee rule rather than a change to the asset being sent (CoinStats)

items.title: Edel reports a theft of about $300,000 in EDEL tokens, with the stolen tokens since sold or blocked
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 14, 2026 · 5:42 AM ET)
- **Edel reports a theft of about $300,000 in EDEL tokens, with the stolen tokens since sold or blocked** — Edel reported the theft on November 12 and said it was working with authorities and exchanges to investigate; in a follow-up that day it said all the stolen tokens had either been sold or blocked by exchanges and promised a detailed post-mortem, without giving a breakdown between the two outcomes, and the notices do not identify the affected wallets or establish that Canton's network or Edel's other products were compromised (CantonNews)
- **Canton 3.7.3 maintenance release fixes a sequencer resource leak and tightens party replication checks** — The November 12 release addresses a resource leak that could increase sequencer CPU and memory use over several days and tightens checks around party replication, the process of bringing a participant's contract data onto another node; operators should read the upgrade notes before applying it, as changes affect experimental traffic top-ups, replication rules and monitoring labels, and publication of the release does not mean every MainNet operator has upgraded (CantonNews)
- **Canton Coin burns offset only about half of recent issuance, at 439.3 million burned against 798.9 million scheduled over 30 days** — A holder analysis summarised by CoinMarketCap puts the latest 30-day burn at 439.3 million CC against 798.9 million CC scheduled for issuance, and argues institutional usage must translate into fee-paying activity to improve the token's outlook; the author disclosed holding CC (CoinMarketCap)
- **Progmat's scale in Japan's security-token market underpins its tokenized government bond build on Canton** — Progmat, which signed a memorandum of understanding with Digital Asset announced November 10 to build tokenized Japanese government bonds, already handles 51 of Japan's 103 publicly disclosed security-token projects, about ¥290.6 billion of roughly ¥470.3 billion issued; four MUFG group entities will test bond-for-cash settlement and the full repo lifecycle in live testing this month, the first phase connects Progmat's issuance platform to Canton and to Japan's book-entry transfer register, and 24/7 programmable settlement remains a project target, not a finished product (Genfinity)

items.title: Ledger Enterprise brings hardware-enforced threshold self-custody to Canton, targeting the single-validator risk in its wallet design
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 4:42 PM ET)
- **Ledger Enterprise brings hardware-enforced threshold self-custody to Canton, targeting the single-validator risk in its wallet design** — A Canton party is usually hosted by a single validator whose operator controls the node software and could in principle change local parameters to bypass standard controls; Ledger instead separates control of the asset from any one operator with a multi-validator setup that requires at least two validators to confirm a transaction, enforces the same threshold again at the signer level inside its HSMs and personal security devices so a compromised operator cannot lower it at the validator, and requires external parties to sign submitted transactions, with client keys held in FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified hardware (Ledger Enterprise)
- **Zenith's EVM testnet for Canton is publicly live, letting Ethereum developers deploy unmodified Solidity against Canton rails** — The public testnet runs under chain ID 936485 with a faucet, public RPC and explorer, and its external_call primitive lets a Daml contract invoke a Solidity contract inside the same transaction so a Canton-native leg and an EVM leg settle together or not at all; the first milestone is complete, the second targets a demonstrated composability run on mainnet, and support for a Solana virtual machine execution layer is planned next (Bitrue)
- **New Canton–XRP comparison puts Canton Coin's supply growth at about 8.6% this year, ahead of XRP's circulating expansion** — On CoinMarketCap figures, CC supply grew about 8.55% from 36.82 billion at the end of 2025 to 39.97 billion by late October, while circulating XRP grew 4.4% over the same span and XRP's total supply fell by about 158,000 coins as transaction fees are destroyed; the comparison notes CC carries no maximum supply on the major trackers because it is minted as network rewards, whereas XRP was created at inception (Phemex)
- **Ledger Wallet's Canton support runs on a two-validator co-validation model operated with Kiln** — Ledger operates one validator and Kiln operates the second to Ledger's requirements on key generation, custody, recovery and contractual exit; both validators host the same wallets and both must confirm a transaction before the network accepts the resulting state, while balance reads can fail over between them, and Kiln exports the validator database daily to secure storage controlled by Ledger so Ledger holds an independent copy of the state its wallets rely on (Kiln)

items.title: Fairmint and Blockworks win approval for a shared 2.4 million CC Canton asset-data feed
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 3:12 PM ET)
- **Fairmint and Blockworks win approval for a shared 2.4 million CC Canton asset-data feed** — The Development Fund committee vote posted on November 13 approves one shared proposal, not separate allocations: 1 million CC funds the specification, publishing and checking tools and Fairmint's private-company equity feed, which Blockworks must fetch and validate, and 1.4 million CC funds a second publisher in a second asset class, Blockworks using both feeds in production and a 12-month maintenance commitment; daily snapshots are anchored to a record on Canton so corrections create a new declaration rather than replacing the old one, the two launch feeds publish aggregates only without individual positions or holder identifiers, delivery runs four months, and the vote does not itself mean the feeds are live or the grant has been paid (CantonNews)
- **Progmat's tokenized Japanese government bond working group now counts more than 68 institutions** — The Tokenized Government Bonds and On-Chain Repo group inside Progmat's Digital Asset Co-Creation Consortium, whose members include MUFG Bank, Mizuho Bank, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, State Street Trust and Banking, SBI Securities and Japan Exchange Group's Market Innovation & Research arm, keeps the underlying bonds in the Bank of Japan's book-entry transfer ledger with a designated custodian so the tokens stay tied to Japan's official register; its stated aim is same-day T+0 repo settlement against the traditional next-business-day T+1, and those settlement capabilities remain project goals being tested in the November sandbox phase, not completed features (CryptoPulseDaily)
- **Governance locks bring Super Validator and Featured App locking requirements on-chain from Splice 0.10.0** — CIP-0127 is the functional specification enforcing CIP-0105, which requires Super Validators to lock a share of their lifetime rewards to keep their weight, and CIP-0116, which requires each Featured App provider to lock a minimum amount of CC to gain and keep featured status; every lock must hold at least 10,000 CC, Super Validator locks release over 365.25 days and Featured App locks over 60 days, and the first increments shipping in Splice 0.10.0 run in a compatibility mode built on CIP-0056 two-step transfers to a master on-chain lock manager (Canton Network Docs)

items.title: Canton security advisory warns validators that attackers are targeting operators' internal networks
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 2:12 PM ET)
- **Canton security advisory warns validators that attackers are targeting operators' internal networks** — The October 26 advisory says Canton and Splice have released updated Docker images patching the eMudhra and node.js remote-code-execution vulnerabilities, and urges operators to patch all production components including Splice 0.9.4 and Wallet Gateway 1.13.0, keep root namespace keys offline or in a KMS/HSM, hold large balances only with external keys using Splice sweep automation, and, if compromise is suspected, turn the validator off and contact the Foundation; KMS conversion runbooks are in preparation (Canton Network Forum)
- **PostgreSQL 14 reached end of life on November 12, so Splice nodes must migrate their databases** — The Canton docs say the splice-postgres Helm chart is deprecated and unsupported after that date, so Kubernetes nodes must move to a PostgreSQL instance provisioned outside the Splice charts, with a managed service such as Amazon RDS, Google Cloud SQL or Azure Database recommended, while Docker Compose nodes must move to a newer major version by dump and restore with planned downtime, since bumping the image tag alone will not start on an older data directory (Canton Network Docs)
- **Production deployments show the integration work behind Canton tokenization, from repo to stablecoin clearing** — IntellectEU's account notes EquiLend's 1Source securities-finance platform built on Canton went live in October 2025 with BNY and National Bank of Canada among the first counterparties, Société Générale's first U.S. digital bond issuance ran on Canton, and the Ubyx Clearing Platform is bringing stablecoin clearing to Canton with Paxos, Ripple and Monerium among its issuers and Barclays as a strategic equity partner (IntellectEU)
- **WalletConnect adds Canton support, connecting its wallet network to Canton applications** — Any WalletConnect-enabled wallet can now connect to a supported Canton application, developers integrate once to reach that wallet ecosystem, and WalletConnect says the link opens its millions of users to Canton stablecoins, tokenized deposits, onchain securities and privacy-enabled DeFi, with private keys never exposed and sessions end-to-end encrypted (WalletConnect)

items.title: Canton draft would let Super Validators delegate their governance votes to a separate identity
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)
- **Canton draft would let Super Validators delegate their governance votes to a separate identity** — A draft specification submitted on November 11 by Digital Asset's Raymond Roestenburg, not yet assigned a CIP number, would let a Super Validator operator appoint a separate Canton party to submit its votes through a dedicated voting app and a CIP-0103 wallet, without sharing the operator identity that runs the node; operator and delegate share the node's one vote, the latest vote counts, the two-thirds threshold is unchanged, and the operator can change or revoke the delegate and still vote itself; the work follows a 1 million CC grant funding the governance app, and activation would still need a Super Validator vote on updated software (CantonNews)
- **Fairmint wins approval for a 3.5 million CC Privy toolkit for Canton apps** — The Development Fund proposal passed on November 10 and funds an open-source SDK so applications that already use Privy for login and built-in wallets can sign Canton transactions without building the connection themselves; 900,000 CC covers a public release, documentation and a DevNet demonstration, 600,000 CC a signing component for Canton's Wallet Gateway, and up to 2 million CC — about 57% of the total — is tied to independent MainNet adoption, at 600,000 CC per verified integrator up to three, plus the start of maintenance; the first milestone is estimated at two months after approval (CantonNews)
- **Cashen opens institutional onboarding for cashBTC, a trust-held Bitcoin token built for Canton** — cashBTC is minted when Bitcoin arrives in the reserve and burned before it leaves, keeping one-for-one backing; the reserve Bitcoin is held by a licensed trustee with custody at BitGo Bank & Trust in segregated cold storage, only vetted, onboarded institutions can mint and redeem, and any Canton user can hold, transfer and trade the token and use it for settlement, trading and collateral, with reserve addresses, circulating supply and backing status published on a transparency dashboard (Cashen)

items.title: SEC staff digital-commodity view on Canton Coin returns to focus as markets weigh its limits
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 13, 2026 · 4:12 AM ET)
- **SEC staff digital-commodity view on Canton Coin returns to focus as markets weigh its limits** — Fresh November 13 coverage notes that staff in the SEC's Division of Corporation Finance viewed Canton Coin as a digital commodity under the facts presented by Digital Asset and would not recommend enforcement action over programmatic minting by Super Validators, Validators and application providers if the stated conditions are followed; the coverage stresses the limits — the response is a staff position rather than a Commission action, expresses no legal conclusion, and does not address secondary-market trading of CC (ad-hoc-news)
- **Canton Strategic CEO warns MEV could raise hidden costs for tokenized stock traders** — Mark Wendland said issuers and investors need protection against traders who gain priority over other transactions, arguing that payments to validators can leave other users with less favourable prices; he said Canton is designed to prohibit MEV in structure and practice, with no universal visibility of pending orders and validators unable to accept payments to change their place in the sequence, while a Helius report tracked 1.55 million sandwich transactions and $13.43 million in profit from one Solana program (WEEX)
- **ETP Foundry builds a tokenized-fund toolkit on Canton and seeks its first fund sponsors** — The toolkit lets a fund company launch and run a tokenized fund on Canton without building the plumbing itself: fund shares are a standard Canton token under CIP-56, market makers create and redeem shares in one atomic transaction with the basket or with cash, and the daily net asset value is calculated automatically and signed on the ledger by the fund's own parties; its Foundation-approved validator has run on DevNet since September 24 with test funds holding cBTC, cETH and Canton Coin, and it plans Canton Development Fund applications under RFP 11 and RFP 12 as open tooling, still seeking a Tech & Ops Champion, with its code not yet independently audited and everything still on DevNet (Canton Network Forum)
- **Open-source DEX routing SDK proposed for Canton so apps can route swaps across DEXs from one integration** — The proposed SDK takes two tokens and returns the best route with an unsigned execution plan, with no keys, no signing, no hosted backend and no fees; bridges, wallets and apps could use it as the last-mile swap after bridging without integrating each DEX separately, DEXs join by writing a small adapter and opening a pull request — Cantex and TradeCraft are first on the list — and the Canton DEX Aggregation SDK proposal in the Canton Development Fund is still looking for a champion (Canton Network Forum)

- **Pinnaccle approved as a Featured App as the new Featured App rules take effect** — The Canton Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Pinnaccle for Featured App status, which still needs on-chain approval by the Super Validators; Featured App status boosts the Canton Coin rewards an application earns for the activity it drives on Canton, and the approval arrived alongside version 2.0b of the Featured App Guidance taking effect on November 5 (CC Space)

items.title: Cancore raises $7.2 million seed round to connect Canton assets with public-chain liquidity
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 5:12 PM ET)
- **Cancore raises $7.2 million seed round to connect Canton assets with public-chain liquidity** — The Canton-native platform, live on mainnet since April 2026 as a validator and Featured App, closed the round with Paper Ventures, dao5, ArkStream Capital, X Ventures, MH Ventures and Proof of Talk; as of October 1 it had processed more than $53.2 million in lifetime volume across more than 84,000 trades and generated over $538,000 in protocol revenue, and will use the capital to expand to additional networks and liquidity sources (The Defiant)
- **Three Canton apps lose Featured App status over free-traffic abuse** — The Tokenomics Committee, acting on the Featured App Accountability Committee's recommendation, is revoking Featured App status from Grofty Wallet, Yapper Agent and Ibex for abusing free traffic; the revocations now go to Super Validators for on-chain approval, signalling that reward privileges are being actively policed (CC Space)
- **Nasdaq and Send awarded MainNet validator node allocations** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group granted new MainNet validator allocations, including one to Nasdaq, Inc. and three to Send, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments (CC Space)
- **Derivnex records the first over-the-counter swap on Canton** — DRW and Marex entered a total return swap on the iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade Index on October 13, recorded as the first OTC swap on the network (Datawallet)

items.title: Tokenomics Committee approves Stable Coin (SBC) as a Featured App on Canton
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 4:12 PM ET)
- **Tokenomics Committee approves Stable Coin (SBC) as a Featured App on Canton** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Stable Coin Inc.'s SBC application for Featured App status, which now goes to Super Validators for on-chain approval; the same notice confirms an additional Super Validator weight release for Canton Strategic Holdings under the Digital Asset Treasury programme (CC Space)
- **EDX Markets launches CBTC spot trading, bringing Bitcoin-backed assets to Canton institutions** — EDX Markets partnered with BitSafe to launch spot trading of CBTC, BitSafe's Bitcoin-backed asset on Canton backed 1:1 by Bitcoin, in its first availability on a centralized exchange; Granite River Trading supports liquidity, with CBTC/USD perpetuals planned in the coming weeks and Canton Coin planned as eligible collateral (Morningstar)
- **Canton builds out its South Korea presence through Shinhan, Hanwha and LG CNS** — Shinhan Financial Group has cooperation and strategic investment links with the Canton Foundation, including Shinhan Asset Management approved as a Super Validator, Hanwha Investment & Securities has partnered with Digital Asset and invested in the company, and LG CNS is exploring Canton-based services and infrastructure (Bitrue)
- **Tokenomics Committee pauses Wintip's Featured App status after flagged activity** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee voted to pause Featured App status for Wintip (Winsnip) on MainNet after on-chain activity was flagged for review by the Accountability Committee; Featured App status boosts the rewards an application earns, so the pause materially changes its economics (CC Space)

items.title: Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 3:42 PM ET)
- **Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton** — Upflam has dropped its invite-only access: anyone can now sign up, create a Canton wallet and take payments through payment links, invoices, donation pages, embeddable buttons, recurring AutoPay and a WooCommerce plugin, with a 0.1% fee on incoming payments (CC Space)
- **First trades of tokenized U.S. equity under SEC Innovation Exemption executed on Canton** — Shares of Canton Strategic Holdings (NASDAQ: CNTN) traded on November 4 on TSV, the permissioned venue for tokenized NMS stocks on Canton, with Five North as seller, DRW Cumberland as buyer and Flowdesk as liquidity provider; Fairmint, the SEC-registered transfer agent, recorded the shares and the trades settled atomically, the first of their kind under the SEC's September 17 Innovation Exemption (Morningstar)
- **Wells Fargo among organizations awarded MainNet validator allocations** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group awarded additional MainNet validator node allocations, including three to Wells Fargo alongside Visoty, Cartumi, Winsnip, Winnode and Otoclick, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments (CC Space)
- **Canton Foundation launches Community Research Grants with up to 50,000 CC per month** — The Foundation has launched Canton Community Research Grants, with up to 50,000 CC per month available beginning in November 2026 at the Foundation's discretion for original research and educational content (CoinStats)

items.title: DTCC plans to connect its Tokenization Service to Solana in the second half of 2027
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)
- **DTCC plans to connect its Tokenization Service to Solana in the second half of 2027** — The service launched on Canton and DTCC's private network on October 28, so Canton remains its first live venue; the announcement signals a future multi-network strategy rather than a move away from Canton (CoinMarketCap)
- **Blockdaemon faces losing 4.0 escrowed Super Validator weight after its milestones expire** — Blockdaemon's adoption milestones under CIP-94 expired without being met, so the Foundation has proposed stripping the 4.0 escrowed reward weight held via MPCH in the first visible application of the Super Validator Accountability Framework, with voting running until November 17 (CC Space)
- **Rome Protocol launches Ostia, a zero-knowledge EVM chain settling on Canton** — Ostia is live on Canton DevNet as an Ethereum-compatible chain whose blocks are proved with zero-knowledge proofs and settled in a single Canton transaction, with a bridge that moves Canton Coin and ERC-20 tokens between the two sides (CC Space)
- **Digital Asset and the American Idea Foundation select Canton for a three-state RISE benefits pilot** — The pilot is planned for Q1 2027 pending federal approval, with Canton coordinating payment rules while limiting access to recipients' sensitive information; locations and participating programs have not been disclosed (CoinMarketCap)

items.title: Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 2:12 PM ET)
- **Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin** — The Foundation approved almost 15.8 million CC, worth about $1.55 million, to fund RedStone's open-source Canton Access and Privacy Standard (CAPS) tool, letting institutions value transactions from a shared reference price without revealing their agreed settlement amounts; initial pricing covers tokenized funds, private-market assets and structured products under the Apache 2.0 license (Cointelegraph)
- **Uber completes 24/7 treasury pilot on Canton with HSBC, Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb and Fireblocks** — Uber used HSBC Tokenized Deposits to buy Franklin Templeton tokenized money market fund shares on Tradeweb through delivery-versus-payment transactions on Canton via Fireblocks, and liquidated part of the holding over a weekend while continuing to earn yield throughout the investment lifecycle (HSBC)
- **Societe Generale accepts $10 million in tokenized Treasuries as collateral on Canton** — The bank's Prime Services & Clearing division accepted the DTCC-tokenized Treasuries as eligible collateral, reflecting them in its existing back-office and collateral systems, and intends to develop support for recurring collateral movements and explore onchain repo financing (Societe Generale)
- **Circle reports 379.9 million Canton Coin held at September 30** — Circle's quarterly filing shows 379,921,930 CC with a fair value of about $48.0 million at September 30, 2026, up in quantity from 367,760,063 CC held at December 31, 2025 (Circle Form 10-Q)

- **OpenZeppelin Daml library and four reference designs clear Canton Dev Fund vote** — The security firm's open-source Daml contracts library and reference designs for a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and a fourth design were approved, giving Canton builders vetted, reusable building blocks (CC Space)

- **CIP-0129 universal burn timeline points to private synchronizers in Q1 2027** — The first phase would apply universal fee burning to private synchronizers, described as ambitious rather than a firm deadline, with volume-based pricing estimated for Q3 2027 (CoinMarketCap)
